architecture.step1: The user describes the task. Dify starts the workflow or agent.
architecture.step2: The model receives the task and the available component definitions.
architecture.step3: The model streams an OpenUI Lang description of the interface.
architecture.step4: The renderer parses the stream and maps it to registered components.
architecture.step5: Dify components display the data and interaction controls.
architecture.step6: A click or form submission starts the next conversation turn.
